method: FIVB rally-point state machine for one set. Every rally winner gains one point. A serving-team win leaves service and positions unchanged; a receiving-team win transfers service and rotates that team clockwise exactly once, with position 2 moving to position 1 and position 1 moving to position 6. Positions are shown from the team's own side: front row 4, 3, 2 and back row 5, 6, 1. A regular set ends at 25 or more with a two-point lead; a deciding set ends at 15 or more with a two-point lead, with no scoring cap. A change-of-ends event is emitted only when the leading score first reaches 8 in a deciding set. Undo restores the complete prior state and scoring is refused after the set. P1-P6 represent starting-lineup slots. Substitutions, libero replacements, sanctions and multi-set matches are not modelled. Names and scores remain only in page memory.

sources.title: FIVB Official Volleyball Rules 2025-2028: Rules 6.1.3, 6.2, 6.3.2, 7.4.1, 7.6.2 and 18.2.2
